Jacksonville Light Boat Parade.verification: The Commons file identifies Southbank Riverwalk, credits Agassiz830 under CC BY-SA 4.0, and supplies coordinates 30.317867,-81.651511 in Downtown Jacksonville. Visually inspected the Commons preview: the pedestrian riverwalk beside the St. Johns River with downtown buildings and bridges. The guide names the North and Southbank Riverwalks as viewing areas. This is route context; no boat parade is pictured.
